item.tib: tshe dbang rigs lnga'i sbyin bsregs nyon mongs kun 'joms
item.coloph: de ltar zhi rgyas sbyin bsregs (sreg) mdo bsdus gzhung/ 'gro la smin phyir 'chi med bdag gis smras/ grub thob rjes 'bang (rje 'bangs) rnams la bka' 'di gtad/ skabs shig bstan pa nyi zla 'char nub dus/ brda ris bris te zangs brag gnas la sbas/ phyis su las 'phro can gyi rnyed par shog sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya// phyis su bdag 'dra gshen spral thugs rje nyi mas phug leb 'o ma stag rtse nas dngos grub du (tu) rnyed ste (de/)lo mang bka' rgya gab slar hor sras rin po che sogs/ las ldan mang po'i skal du shog ser bod yig tu phab pa'o//
